candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The final call consumes that capsule and all common evidence, begins with retract-only authority, transitions to semantic reconstitution only upon an irreducible contradiction witness, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Contradiction-Triggered Authority Phase-Change Dyad
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential nonbranching lineage with one complete executable origin and one evidence-triggered authority-state terminal

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy capsule.

Consume originate_complete_executable and the jointly visible common evidence, retain retract-only authority unless that evidence establishes a contradiction unresolvable by retraction while preserving completeness, then transition authority to semantic reconstitution for the same artifact and emit one policy.
calls.role: evidence-triggered authority-state controller and terminal emitter

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion terminal remains permanently retract-only and cannot add or substitute semantics when shared evidence proves that deletion alone cannot preserve both obligations and executable completeness.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This introduces a previously unreachable constructive authority state and an evidence-caused transition, rather than refining opacity, dependency closure, review, certification, naming, or role granularity.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: A non-deletion-correctable contradiction can be removed while the unchanged sequential lineage emits one complete policy.
mode_certificate.state_transition: Terminal authority changes from monotone retraction to semantic reconstitution for the same single artifact before emission.
mode_certificate.trigger: Jointly visible common evidence establishes a required-obligation contradiction in the incoming complete artifact that cannot be resolved through retraction alone.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace static retract-only terminal authority with an evidence-triggered transition from monotone retraction to semantic reconstitution when shared evidence establishes a non-deletion-correctable contradiction.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The lineage can recover from origin errors requiring constructive semantic correction while preserving a single complete artifact and one terminal policy.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: A permanently retract-only terminal cannot recover when deletion would leave a required obligation unsatisfied or destroy executable completeness.

structural_mutation.after: The terminal edge begins retract-only and transitions to semantic reconstitution authority when jointly visible evidence proves that retraction alone cannot satisfy required obligations while preserving executable completeness.
structural_mutation.before: The terminal edge has one permanent monotone retract-only authority state.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes the terminal edge's causal control semantics and reachable authority states without adding a call, reviewer, certificate, gate, field, role split, or branch.

receipt.role: score-blind R95 emergent_exploration structure architect; never policy code
